method: Normal-size neutral-plus-sixteen labeled sheet and enlarged face landmarks; lower body registration and both loop boundaries inspected.

000.observed: Head lifted frontally, gaze above camera
000.evidence: Chin underside and extended neck show upward pitch; pupils sit toward upper lids; boots stay planted.

022.5.observed: Lifted face yawed toward viewer right
022.5.evidence: Nose projects right of head midpoint and chin stays lifted; similarity to 045 is subtle, but both horizontal right and vertical up remain readable.

045.observed: Rightward head turn with raised chin and eyes
045.evidence: Right nose profile and exposed left cheek establish right yaw; upward eye line and raised chin establish up.

067.5.observed: Predominantly right with slight upward pitch
067.5.evidence: Nose protrudes screen-right; face remains raised and irises slightly high, approaching the horizontal right cardinal.

090.observed: Clear head and face toward screen-right
090.evidence: Nose tip is at right edge of face, near cheek occludes and gaze points right; frontal belt and feet do not rotate.

112.5.observed: Right turn beginning a downward head bow
112.5.evidence: Nose/face still offset right; chin lowers toward collar and upper bangs slope downward over eye line.

135.observed: Bowed face directed right and downward
135.evidence: Visible right nose/cheek projection preserves right yaw; hat top expands and chin tucks toward tie for down.

157.5.observed: Strong downward bow with residual right yaw
157.5.evidence: Nose and face opening remain slightly right of head midpoint; fringe lowered across eyes and chin tucked. Boundary to 180 changes face direction without scale/foot jump.

180.evidence: Hat top and bangs dominate, eyes lowered/closed, nose and chin point into collar; feet stay on idle baseline.

202.5.observed: Downward head bow slightly toward screen-left
202.5.evidence: Nose and exposed eye area shift left of head center; chin remains down near tie and hat top remains prominent.

225.evidence: Nose and face opening project left while fringe covers upper eyes and chin remains tucked for down.

247.5.observed: Mostly left with slight downward pitch
247.5.evidence: Left nose contour and left gaze are clear; chin remains lowered and eye line points beneath neutral horizontal.

270.evidence: Nose tip/face opening lie screen-left, visible opposite cheek and red irises look left; torso and feet remain frontal.

292.5.observed: Left turn with beginning upward pitch
292.5.evidence: Nose stays on left side of head; chin lifts, collar-to-chin space increases and eyes look above-left.

315.evidence: Left-facing nose and cheek preserve left yaw, while upward eye line and raised chin establish up; no reversal toward right.

337.5.observed: Nearly frontal lifted face with slight left gaze
337.5.evidence: Chin underside exposed and eyes high establish up; nose and irises subtly left of head center preserve left half. Flows into 000 without body drift.

continuity_review: Metric warnings at 000->022.5 and 157.5->180 correspond to head yaw and the frontal bow. Native-size visual review shows small registered changes, no clipping, alpha holes, reversed gaze, identity break, or conspicuous size jump. Neighbor differences are not evenly distributed; 022.5 and 045 are similar.

Idle blink is visible; gaits alternate and face correct direction; greeting arm remains attached; jump lifts 30px and lands within 2px of idle; failure slumps and resolves, waiting asks with open palm, active-work checks harness with planted feet, review uses chin and head gestures.
